name: MSEarthMCQ
intro: MSEarthMCQ 是 MSEarth 地球科学多模态基准的多项选择子集。它从40万余篇论文中抽取图像、原始图注和正文证据，由 GPT-4o 生成精炼图注与候选问题，再经五模型及 70B+ 模型参与的三阶段投票和地球科学硕士专家验证，最终保留2,784道覆盖五大地球圈层的图像落地问题。
org: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
build_method: 论文挖掘, 多智能体生成筛选, 专家验证
task_type: 地球科学多项选择问答
eval_feature: 论文证据, 三阶段多模型投票, 专家验证
build_method_en: Paper Mining, Multi-agent Generation and Filtering, Expert Validation
eval_feature_en: Paper evidence, three-phase model voting, expert validation
intro_en: MSEarthMCQ is the multiple-choice subset of the MSEarth multimodal Earth-science benchmark. It mines figures, original captions, and supporting text from more than 400K papers; GPT-4o generates refined captions and candidate questions, followed by three-phase voting with five-model and 70B-plus-model stages and validation by master's-level Earth-science experts. The final release contains 2,784 figure-grounded questions across the five Earth spheres.

drawio_review_note: Source audit locked to the current arXiv:2505.20740v3 revision dated 2026-05-03, official GitHub commit d3ad753c2a4d7ba244d8bf8ece5ec3ba5413cc39, and official MSEarth-Data/MSEarth-Benchmark-MCQ revision 0eea8f4d9ae7c9f37a10de66f142d585c7f3c53a. The diagram preserves the 400K-plus PDF source; MinerU conversion and five-sphere classification; repeated Qwen2.5-VL-72B Earth-observation filtering to about 83K papers; regex alignment, >2-sentence context rule, 64,560 papers, and 289,891 figures; valid-context-only GPT-4o caption refinement and MCQ generation; exact Phase A/B five-model and Phase C three-model rules; mutually exclusive Phase A outcomes; 900/1,800/300 sampling; master's-level expert screening and 216 invalid MCQ removals; exact 2,784/2,117/667/1,255/1,529 release totals; and image/question/original-caption evaluation input. The official evaluation first regex-parses an option when possible, otherwise exactly compares the raw answer text or content; the separate MiniLM script is an optional post-process for initially wrong rows from poor instruction-following models and can only flip an error to correct. Processing exceptions produce no result row, so reported accuracy uses evaluated mapped result rows rather than a fixed denominator of 2,784. The official dataset is public and ungated, but its dataset card has no license metadata; only the OpenDataLab source-paper corpus is explicitly stated by the paper to be CC BY 4.0, so no dataset-license claim is made. The paper does not specify a random seed for benchmark sampling or a numeric regex-failure rate. Formal publication evidence [site-a11p-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1721×1321 (English) and 1719×1321 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1719×1319 and 1717×1319. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
